# soapysdr-module-uhd

**SoapySDR driver module for Ettus USRP hardware**

- **Version recorded:** 0.4.1
- **Categories:** `sdr-hardware`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/pothosware/SoapyUHD/wiki>

## What it does

A SoapySDR plugin that wraps libuhd, so a USRP appears as an ordinary SoapySDR device to any program speaking that interface.

## Why you would want it

USRPs are driven through UHD, which is its own API, while a great deal of SDR software speaks SoapySDR and nothing else. This is what lets a USRP be used with software written for cheaper hardware -- CubicSDR, SDR++, gqrx and the rest. It is the opposite direction from `uhd-soapysdr`, which this catalog also carries; both are built from the same upstream source and the names are easy to swap.

## Before it will work

UHD itself and the firmware images a USRP needs -- `uhd-host` carries the downloader, and a device without matching firmware fails to initialise.

## Install and launch

- **Installed by name only** — it is in no profile.
- **Install:** `hammunition install soapysdr-module-uhd --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `soapysdr-module-uhd`

## Known problems

A layer over a layer: a fault can be in the application, in SoapySDR, in this module, in UHD or in the firmware, and the error usually names only the outermost. Test with UHD's own utilities first to establish the device works at all. Advanced USRP features are not all expressible through SoapySDR, so the native API remains right for those.
